# XEOscan

> XEOscan is a free tool that scans a website and returns a prioritised, severity-weighted report on how ready it is to be read and cited by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and by classic search. No signup, results in seconds.

## Core
- [XEOscan home and free scanner](https://xeoscan.ai/): run a free AI SEO and classic SEO scan on any website
- [Scoring rubric](https://xeoscan.ai/rubric): every check we run, in plain English, with the severity weights

## Learn
- [AI SEO guide](https://xeoscan.ai/ai-seo-guide): the full guide to making a site citable by AI and ranked by search
- [What is GEO](https://xeoscan.ai/what-is-geo): plain definition of Generative Engine Optimization
- [GEO vs AEO vs SEO](https://xeoscan.ai/geo-vs-aeo-vs-seo): how the disciplines differ
- [AI crawlers list](https://xeoscan.ai/ai-crawlers-list): AI user-agents and how to allow or block them
- [llms.txt guide](https://xeoscan.ai/what-is-llms-txt): what llms.txt is and a template
- [Get cited by ChatGPT](https://xeoscan.ai/get-cited-by-chatgpt): practical playbook
- [Optimise for Perplexity](https://xeoscan.ai/optimise-for-perplexity): practical playbook
- [Google AI Overviews](https://xeoscan.ai/google-ai-overviews): what they are and how to be included

## About
- [Disclaimer](https://xeoscan.ai/disclaimer): what the scan does and does not measure
- [Privacy](https://xeoscan.ai/privacy): what data is collected and how long it is kept
- [Contact](https://xeoscan.ai/contact): questions, bug reports, data requests
